reviews.text: Thanks to Hector especially for his endless patience and for helping me understand Kyara a little better! It's been a big change for both of us.

Thanks to Hector for his patience and excellent guidance; he has greatly helped us understand our dog's insecurity. Thanks also to Gaspar, who, after a conversation, allowed us to resume sessions and continue working to help our dog change. Many thanks.

A huge thank you to Héctor for helping Maradona. Our puppy came home in a very difficult situation, with fears and insecurities stemming from her time in the pound and shelter that we didn't understand and weren't able to manage. In every class, Héctor has given us tools, helped us understand her, and above all, made us see her progress and encouraged us when Mara was feeling her worst. In addition to the classes, we've had daily support that has allowed us to improve the exercises day by day and for Mara to improve much faster.

Now she's calmer, enjoys walks, and rests well at home. Thank you, Héctor!

Javi is the third trainer we've worked with for our Shiba Inu, Hash, and he's been the best at reading and understanding him.

He's taught us how to understand his reactivity and how to remove him from the equation to avoid conflict.

If we're thinking about getting another dog or need to recommend him to someone, we'll definitely think of Javi!

Javier has been an incredible trainer. He perfectly understood Hash (the best Shiba Inu) and gave us guidelines to better understand him. Now he's much less reactive and trusts us a lot. Without a doubt, if we have any problems in the future, we'll call on him again 🙌🏼🐾

We took the bonding course with Paula and we couldn't be happier! Kiwi, our 2-year-old dog, has improved tremendously; she's much calmer and more obedient. We'll continue working with Kiwi in the other group classes they offer at Kawana.

Everything was excellent. We opted for the 10-class program. The Kawana center is very good; its staff is the best of the best. The attention we received from the beginning was exceptional. Johana explained everything about how the center works perfectly.
Javier, Stefie's trainer, immediately knew what she needed. He helped her and us a lot with her training. He was always attentive and explained perfectly what we should and shouldn't do. Stefie connected with him very well.

Thank you, Javier, for helping us understand Stefie better and for your patience and teaching. We are delighted with you.

And thank you, Kawana, for everything you offer for our canine friends.
If you are looking for an excellent dog training center, this is the best. I recommend it 100%.

I found Kawana because my two dogs (Sirius and Loki) had some issues they needed to work on. One was related to stress (urinating inside the house), and the other to anxiety about going outside, which prevented Loki from going for walks and socializing with other dogs.

It was hard work, and I have to say that most of the work fell on us, the owners. We had to learn what was best for them, which is ultimately the most important thing.

Jorge not only accompanied us to the classes, but he went above and beyond. Sirius and Loki love him; every time he came to the classes, they greeted him with enthusiasm and joy. I can say, after 10 classes together, that Sirius no longer goes inside—and that's despite going through a move, which is incredibly stressful for everyone (both humans and dogs)! Loki can now go for walks relaxed and, little by little, is able to approach and socialize with other dogs.

Being indoors allowed them both to relax, not be so attached to us, have their own space, rest, and enjoy their lives.

My husband and I decided to take the classes because they deserve the very best, and we are 100% sure that the positive change it had on them (and surely on their health) was worth it.

Thank you Jorge, Aria, and Partner <3 for joining us on this adventure! We will always be grateful to you.

An incredible experience where, in addition to enjoying time with your pet, you achieve things you thought were impossible, things that are incredibly useful in your daily life. Highly recommended. Thank you, Alfonso and Gaspar, for your dedication and help. You are an excellent team.

Excellent classes! They teach you how to properly manage dogs' emotions and behaviors, and they leave transformed!

Highly recommended for anyone who wants a well-balanced dog and enjoys the excellent treatment from the instructors.

We've had 10 private training sessions with Héctor and have learned a lot. It wasn't an easy challenge, as our dog is a husky-labrador mix and very sensitive to any stimulus. His patience, empathy, and enthusiasm make him a true professional in dog training. Thank you so much for everything!

Our experience with Kawana has been incredible, thanks to the classes taught by Miguel (a true professional). We've been going mainly because of the newest member of the family, Tinto, a six-month-old puppy, along with his sisters Raksha and Kira. In just five sessions, we've learned so much that will be incredibly useful in our daily lives, making everything much easier with three dogs. Miguel has made it so that every Friday we go with such enthusiasm and excitement to learn new things. The way he teaches the classes has been super fun, motivating, and of course, rewarding. Watching him teach us and seeing everything come together is like magic—magic that needs to be practiced daily. Thank you, thank you, and thank you! We'll be resuming classes soon to practice everything we've learned. A huge hug from Antonio and Nines, Tinto, Raksha, and Kira to the whole Kawana group, and especially to Miguel.

We took the puppy course and loved it. They answered so many of our questions and covered many situations that, in most cases, no matter how many YouTube training videos you watch, are always better experienced firsthand so you can react and learn in time.

After the course, we were able to take private lessons with the same instructor, Héctor (I highly recommend him!), and we're now in a new phase of assimilating real-life situations on the street, at home, with other dogs... it's truly worthwhile.

Javier was a huge help with our Golden Retriever. His knowledge and experience have allowed us to understand our puppy's needs at every stage and how to communicate them to him, setting boundaries in a structured and consistent way that reinforces his learning over time.

Thank you so much, Javier and the Kawana team, for helping us understand our beloved dogs and not just teach them to obey.
Thank you for your 5 stars! 🌟 We really appreciate you taking a moment to rate us. We're here for you and your furry friend for anything you need. Hugs from the Kawana team! 🐾💚 …

It's been a great experience meeting Javier to train our dog Nora.

Thank you so much.

We couldn't be happier with the experience. From the very first moment, Javi has been a friendly, kind, and professional trainer. He quickly won our trust, and especially that of our little dog, Nora, whom he has treated with respect, patience, and lots of love. ☺️☺️ We loved his positive reinforcement approach, which made everything so easy.
Nora learned quickly, and I think she enjoyed it too.
He also gave us very useful tools to continue reinforcing her learning every day.
100% recommended.

We found out about this place through a friend and tried their group excursions in the summer, which we really enjoyed. Following that, we started private lessons with Miguel, and it's been a fantastic decision. He's taught us many exercises (and, above all, the reasons behind them) and helped us understand the underlying issues our dog might be having. Highly recommended!
Our deepest gratitude to Bryan and the rest of the team for helping us manage Sidra's fears and intensity. Thank you for all your support. You guys are awesome!

Héctor and the entire Kawana team are wonderful. From summer walks to introduce your dog to the water to more advanced classes, there's sure to be an activity for you and your furry friend. Investing in them is something that lasts a lifetime, and Kawana has been the best place to do it 💛

We had individual lessons and shared our concerns about our dog and the barking in the garden. They really know a lot, they taught us about commands… but not about dealing with the barking itself (I guess it's reactivity), which was our main problem…
We finished the course with my dog ​​Bruno. We want to thank Miguel for his support and training; we were very satisfied. Thank you so much!

I'm so happy with Kawana. Héctor is fantastic! He's great, makes the sessions enjoyable, and above all, he's helped us organize our thoughts and understand our dog much better 🙂 We'll probably come back to them if we need more support, and we're also keen to participate in one of their group courses.
I recommend them 100%!!!
Thank you so much for your 5 stars, María Ángeles! 🌟 They mean a lot to us. …

I'm absolutely delighted with Kawana and Héctor, who was our teacher. From the very first moment, he understood our needs and knew how to meet them both inside and outside of class. We felt supported and guided every step of the way, and on top of that, he was incredibly kind and had an exceptionally positive attitude.
Bali and I took the connection course, and it was wonderful to see our bond grow stronger with each class. So much so that after finishing the course, we decided to continue with private lessons. One hundred percent recommended; they are amazing and have a genuine love for dogs that is contagious. Without a doubt, they are the best.

It's been wonderful sharing all of Chloe's learning with Javier. He's very professional, kind, and above all, fun to learn with. I will always recommend him and we will go back to him to resolve doubts and refresh our memories. 😍❤️ …

Hello, I'd like to share our experience at Kawana. We had personalized training sessions, and I want to emphasize the exceptional professionalism and dedication of every member of the team. In our case, our trainer was Héctor, and we couldn't be happier with him. He always adapted to our dog's individual needs and made everything as easy as possible. He demonstrated his passion for the profession at every moment. We couldn't have chosen a better center. Thank you all for allowing us to learn so much.
Thank you so much Carolina for your review, Best regards.
Highly recommended! It was a wonderful experience. Many thanks to Paula and Javier, our puppy teachers, who were fantastic! I would definitely do it again, and we will again to learn even more!

What a fantastic course! We learned so much during the month-long course. Essential if you want to start building a good relationship with your dog 🐶
And Hector was so nice!

We did the puppy course with Aloy, a little puppy with a lot of fears. And the change in these weeks has been incredible! We want to thank Kawana for providing this opportunity, with a safe space for them, and such amazing professionals! A special mention to Héctor, our super teacher! Always attentive to everyone, patient, and making the classes fun, not just for the dogs. We not only had a great time, but we also learned so much! ❤️ We're updating the review because we've continued with individual classes with Héctor. And I have nothing but words of gratitude for him and the whole team.
Aloy is a completely different dog now, more confident, almost fearless, calm at home, and we can go out without worry. We've even gotten her to love the water and to know who to greet and who not to.

Together we've built confidence and worked hard so she can go off-leash and come back without any problems. We've learned so much and felt so comfortable... we can only highly recommend them!

Thank you for everything, guys ❤️
Thank you for the 5 stars, Isabel! 🐾 If you have any questions or would like to share more about your experience, we're happy to help. Hugs from the Kawana team! 💚 …

Hello!

We have a file and record for everyone we work with, and we're very close to each of them.

Who are you?
Thank you so much for your 5-star review, Yoana! 🐾 We're so happy to have your feedback. We're here for you and your furry friend if you need anything. Big hugs from the Kawana team! 💚 …

Completely unprofessional. I have a 10-month-old German Shepherd who was supposed to start a group walk with this company today. During the week, we gave a description of each participant in the group. We mentioned that my dog ​​barks when she's on a leash, and that was the main reason we signed up for this walk—to correct the behavior. The day of the walk arrived, and the so-called dog trainers kicked my dog ​​out after just 5 minutes for barking. You're all just a bunch of con artists. You want a perfect walk without any effort, but you still charge, of course!

These five classes have helped us immensely, and we want to express our heartfelt gratitude to Hector, who has been with us throughout. We were worried because we already have a large dog, and a Chihuahua recently joined the family. We were afraid that the larger dog, due to her weight and strength, might hurt her. But now, thanks to Hector's advice, all three of them are safe and sound at home. Thank you so much!

We took the bonding course with Javier Castaño and we loved it!!
It helped us a lot to understand our dog and learn how to control him. Javi is a great professional who, despite it being a group course, helped us with the individual needs and questions of each dog and owner. The course is very well structured and perfect for young dogs and first-time owners. We will definitely take Kawana's courses again in the future!! 😊

We completed the basic obedience course with Nara over two separate months because she hurt her paw, and it was fantastic!

First of all, a huge thank you to Javi, Paula, Mariano, and Sara for their patience with the three of us!
We also want to thank you for making it easy to complete the course (Nara dislocated a toe, and we had a two-week break).
The classes progressed at a great pace; the material in the last few classes was a little more challenging, but we managed!
There was also a lot of feedback, both during the classes themselves and through the WhatsApp group where we had to send our homework.

In short, it was a very enriching experience for us, and we can only express our gratitude for the work you do. Thank you so much!
Thank you for rating our dog training service, best regards.
He is the best trainer I have ever met and the best for my dogs during training

Although we couldn't finish the course (our dog got sick and had to rest), the classes we did attend were very enjoyable and fun, and we learned quite a few things with the help of Javi and Mario. Thank you so much, Kawana!

Working with Javier has been an absolute pleasure. He's taken it step by step, correcting our little one from the ground up, and we've seen changes in a very short time. His constant follow-up showed us that he was thinking about our situation not only during the time he was with us, but he was always trying to find solutions even when he wasn't with the dog during the week. We're definitely going to continue the classes after the summer.
The experience with Javier was incredible, always punctual, willing to help and resolving all the doubts we had.

I'm so happy with the results I've gotten with my furry friend. I didn't have much hope, but I was really eager to try and make my dog ​​happier, and Jorge has taught me so much.

My dog ​​had a dual personality. She's very sociable outside the neighborhood, but in my neighborhood, she was a wild animal! Every time she saw a dog, a bus, a truck, or a motorcycle, she would go crazy and get into such a vicious cycle that she would bite me.
Jorge taught me how to understand her, how to observe her, how to try to prevent her from getting into that cycle with a few tips, and how to understand that it wasn't aggression, but fear.

I admit that at first I didn't have much faith because my dog ​​is a Caucasian Shepherd, not a very well-known breed, and I didn't know if I would find someone who understood her, but I was wrong. Jorge has taught me so much. My dog ​​and I are much closer now, and I've learned to understand and respect her.

I'm no longer afraid to go outside, and although her reactivity hasn't completely disappeared, it has decreased significantly.
You have to trust the process, and I will always be grateful that I chose you all! ❤️

I want to thank Javier, Tula's teacher, for his great work and support in helping me solve my Tula's little problems.

Thank you so much, Javi, it's been a pleasure working with Kawana and with you.
Thank you very much, Delia. Best regards
Thank you very much for the rating, Hugo. Best regards

Honestly, I wasted my money. We went to the first class, which was supposed to be a demonstration so they could see the dog. We told them the dog was already trained elsewhere and that we just wanted to correct its reactivity because it had been attacked. They said they could help, but in reality, they couldn't. It was mostly just sit-down training and little else. They didn't even train the dogs together or anything; the exercises were pointless. We lost our money. They promised so much, but in reality, they delivered nothing. They didn't help us at all with the reactivity; it was a waste of both money and time. It's unacceptable that the "training areas" are full of broken glass and other debris that the dogs could cut themselves on. It looks like a dump. If I could pay in installments, I would have canceled the first month's membership.

We took the puppy course with Paula and Alfonso, and they taught us lots of tricks to help our little one relax and understand what's going on around him. Teaching him "no" in a positive way and self-control was one of the things that helped us the most with our 4-month-old Dalmatian puppy. There's still a lot to learn, but with the right tools, everything is easier. Kawana makes things very easy and they're very loving with the puppies. We'll definitely be back for future courses ❤️
An incredible experience where they helped us lay the foundation for our puppy. Paula is a spectacular professional who is always there for us, adapting to the requests and needs of the students.
We took the puppy course and the experience was great!!

I want to thank the Kawana team, especially Paula, the teacher. She's a true professional. It's incredible how you can learn to train an animal with love, dedication, and patience. Thank you for everything; we'll miss you. Achilles thanks you and says he wants to keep learning, that he'll be an obedient Cane Corso, with the rules he learned at Kawana and lots of love.
Having just finished the puppy course, I can only express my gratitude for the learning experience. 100% recommended. The team was wonderful; we'll be back in September. Sara and Bono

I took my puppy Kylian to the Kawana puppy course. The experience was fantastic. Paula is an excellent professional; her love for animals is evident. We learned how to call our puppies and get them to obey, how to reward them when they're calm, how to teach them tricks, proper leash handling, how to prevent them from jumping on our food, how to introduce them to other dogs and people, how to keep them from being touched by unwanted people, and above all, how to read their moods to avoid unpleasant situations. I'm very happy and eager to take another course to continue working with my little dog. It's worth every penny. On the last day, we had a picnic, and the dogs swam in a river—it was wonderful. They also offer follow-up via WhatsApp, sending videos and allowing you to ask questions. I highly recommend it to anyone who has dogs to learn how to properly care for them.

Javi has done an excellent job with Kira. He's taught us how to understand her and how to use techniques to keep her calmer at home and on walks. At least now living with our furry friend is possible, and with practice, we're improving every day. Thank you so much for your professionalism!

We couldn't be happier with Bryan and all the work he's doing with our dog.

From day one, he instilled a great deal of confidence in us. He's a true professional, very approachable, patient, and always willing to answer any questions and give us advice on how to continue working with our dog at home. He explains everything very clearly and makes sure you understand the reasoning behind each exercise.

Our dog is five years old, and honestly, we thought many of her behaviors were beyond help. However, from the very first sessions, we started noticing an improvement, which gave us so much hope and motivation to keep working with her.

We will definitely continue with him because we are thrilled with the results and the way he works. We wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone who wants to improve their relationship with their dog and learn to understand them much better.

Thank you so much, Bryan, for your dedication, your friendly approach, and all the help you're giving us!
Wonderful experience with Tofu! Jorge has helped us find better ways to structure his routine and be as calm as possible.

My two Maltipoo puppies, Grace and Curro, recently completed a training course with Javier Castaño, and the experience was outstanding. Javier's sessions are always dynamic and different, and his professionalism and patience with my puppies were truly remarkable. I will definitely continue working with him in a few months to achieve new goals. He inspires you to keep learning so you can enjoy your dogs even more. Congratulations to Kawana on the wonderful team you have!
Hardworking, friendly, and efficient. Delighted with the result.

We've been spending time with Capo, our teenage Great Dane, and he's improved tremendously in his interactions with other dogs. Bryan's classes have been super dynamic, fun, and incredibly useful. Taking the pups for walks and helping them relieve themselves is so important for them during this time of year.

We started classes with Hector to help our Maltipoo puppy with his anxiety, mainly at home, and it has completely changed our lives! He was a nervous puppy who never stayed still, and now he's a calm dog who knows how to have fun but also rest and relax. There's still work and consistency to be done to keep improving, but we 100% recommend the classes and especially Hector!

We took a course with our dog Lilo and we couldn't be happier with the experience. It was absolutely worth it, and the results were noticeable in her behavior from the very beginning.
Paula is a true professional, as well as a very friendly and approachable person. Her classes are a real joy because they are so engaging, practical, and fun, making learning easy for both our furry friends and their humans.
Thank you so much, Paula, for your dedication, patience, and for teaching both Lilo and us so much.

It was a great success for us to meet Brayan and his entire team of professionals.

We want to thank them for everything they've taught us and our dog, Mia! We've learned so much from their training methods. She can't speak, but from her behavior, we can tell she's incredibly grateful for your teachings.
We can only say a thousand thanks for everything. Greetings from M Carmen, Julia, and Mia!
Big hugs!

We want to express our deepest gratitude to the entire Kawana team, and especially to Bryan, for their professionalism and constant attention to our concerns. In these four weeks, they have taught us how to improve our relationship with our 7-month-old dog, Poly. We have learned to understand canine behavior much better and to detect subtle signals that anticipate actions, and as a result, we have noticed a strengthening of our bond with our pet. In just one month, Poly pulls much less on the leash, comes when called even in highly distracting situations due to the presence of people and other dogs, hardly picks things up from the floor anymore, and in general, she seems much less insecure than when we started the training. The recommended interactive toys help her stay calm, and in recent days she has barely barked or growled at the neighbors when we run into each other in the building entrance. We have found the indirect socialization and introductions to other dogs particularly helpful. In short, although we know we must continue working on the guidelines we have learned, we have noticed a very positive change in Poly, and it is only right that other people and their dogs can benefit from the training provided by Kawana. We'll stay in touch. Thank you so much for everything and happy summer to all!

Rita, Ángel, and Poly

The work they've done with my 5-month-old Rottweiler is incredible. They've taught us incredibly valuable things for everyday life and given us a great foundation to build upon. I'll definitely be back.
Thank you so much for your review, Orlando. Best regards

Having Héctor as our trainer has been incredible. We have a very intense puppy... very intense indeed, and Héctor has given us clear and simple guidelines. It's all been super easy, friendly, and he inspires a lot of confidence. Thank you for everything.

Hector has guided us step by step with our puppy, from group classes to individual sessions. He's very patient and gives clear guidelines to improve our relationship. We still have a lot of work ahead of us, but we have the knowledge and tools. Thank you, Hector, for guiding us on this adventure, and as I've always said, "it seems like you know it until you do."

We came to Kawana because Tina had a problem that made walks very difficult. As soon as we left the house, she would pull extremely hard on the leash and react to practically anything that moved: runners, bicycles, cars… Walking with her was quite stressful.

Jorge understood what was happening from the very beginning and, instead of looking for quick fixes, he taught us how to work with her through very clear exercises and guidelines. Thanks to his advice and consistency, Tina has significantly reduced her reaction time and, most importantly, has learned to manage situations that used to overwhelm her much better.

In addition to his professionalism, we want to highlight his friendly approach and the way he explains things so that you truly understand how to help your dog. We are very grateful for everything we have learned and for the change we have seen in Tina.

Without a doubt, we recommend Kawana and especially Jorge to anyone who wants to improve their relationship and enjoy walks with their dog.
